title: Call
say: A scripted agent asks for a tool. It cannot choose a URL or a port, and it carries no scopes of its own.

title: Decide
say: After the scope layers, the gateway checks the rate, then the rules. Deny beats hold beats allow, no match means deny, and an evaluation error denies.

title: Forward
say: Only an allowed call reaches a stub tool server on loopback. A denied or held call never does.

title: Hold for a human
say: The third outcome. An attended call waits for a human with a one-shot code. An unattended call is refused at once with a reference and an expiry, and an approval lets the agent's exact retry through once.

title: Record
say: Every decision and answer lands in the decision buffer and in a hash-chained, append-only audit trail you can verify.

title: Scope layers
say: Ping release claim, unverified: four layered scope checks read the verified token before any rule: surface, application, action, end user. The first layer that fails refuses the call.
